trailhead.label: Sevignano (car park by the war memorial on the SP 71), the APT’s start

cautions: A cobbled lane and village streets at the start.
Forest roads and woodland paths, some steep.
About 1 km back on a quiet tarred lane open to cars.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
